title: Termination request with retaliation, FMLA and OWBPA exposure

traps.title: At-will + PIP = safe
traps.why_wrong: Temporal proximity (4 days), first-ever write-up after 7 years, no investigation, accused manager as decision-maker, better-performing comparators, and a direct-evidence email → retaliation and FMLA interference; pushback 'after her leave' doesn't cure

traps.title: Using the 7-day agreement
traps.why_wrong: OWBPA: 21 days, 7-day revocation, advice to consult counsel; release unenforceable (Oubre)

traps.title: No litigation hold
traps.wrong_move: Not instructing preservation of Hale's email

traps.title: Ignoring comparators
traps.why_wrong: Three male comparators lower, none on PIP

traps.title: Recommending 'wait until after leave'
traps.why_wrong: Causation is about the reason, not the date; and the FMLA request itself is protected

oracle.item: recommended_course includes investigation of the complaint and responding to the FMLA request
comparator_analysis identifies lower-performing comparators not on PIP

rubric: Pushback: explains why timing after leave does not cure causation
